title: 12 Best Gothenburg's Seafood Culture
description: Explore Gothenburg's vibrant seafood scene! Discover the best restaurants, from Michelin-starred fine dining to casual market eateries, offering fresh catches and local delicacies.

places.name: Sjömagasinet
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Seafood Platter Royal' or their signature Pan-fried Turbot with brown butter.

places.name: Fiskekrogen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Shellfish Plateau' for a luxurious feast or the Baked Cod with browned butter and horseradish.

places.name: Restaurang Gabriel
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A selection of fresh oysters from various regions and their perfectly cooked Moules Frites.

places.name: Fiskbar 17
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their daily changing 'catch of the day' prepared with a modern twist, and always ask about the chef's special small plates.

places.name: Tullhuset
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Fish and Shellfish Casserole' or any of their daily specials showcasing local catches.

places.name: Kajutan på Eriksberg
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their classic Shrimp Sandwich (Räkmacka) for lunch, or the Pan-fried Plaice for dinner.

places.name: Långedrag Värdshus
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their hearty 'Fish Soup' or the classic 'Skagentoast' (shrimp salad on toast) as a starter.

places.name: Skaldjurscaféet
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A large plate of 'Räkor med aioli' (shrimp with aioli) or the 'Musselsoppa' (mussel soup).

places.name: Restaurang Familjen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Catch of the Day' is always expertly prepared, and their 'Toast Skagen' is a renowned starter.

places.name: Björns Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Always check the specials board for their seafood dishes, which can range from perfectly seared fish to delicate tartares.

places.name: Hooked Seafood Kitchen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Fish and Chips' (often with a unique twist) or a 'Lobster Roll' for a taste of luxury on a budget.

places.name: Restaurang Natur
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Since the menu is seasonal, ask your server for their current fish or shellfish main course, which is always thoughtfully prepared.
